scripts.build: bun run generate:api && bun run build:web
scripts.check: bun run --cwd web check:svelte && bun run --cwd web/packages/api-client typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd web/packages/api-client test && bun run --cwd web test
scripts.generate:api: cargo run --quiet -p manga-server --no-default-features -- openapi export > web/packages/api-client/openapi.json && bun run --cwd web/packages/api-client generate:client
